Queue Implementation Using Array

Problem Statement
Implement a Queue using an array. Perform the following operations:
ENQUEUE x → Insert element x into the queue.
DEQUEUE → Remove the front element from the queue.
After performing all operations, print the elements present in the queue from front to rear.
Input Description
First line contains N, the number of operations.
Next N lines contain queue operations.
Output Description
Print the final queue elements separated by spaces.
Sample Input
5
ENQUEUE 10
ENQUEUE 20
DEQUEUE
ENQUEUE 30
ENQUEUE 40
Sample Output
20 30 40
